note: The RC-wise AMS tables are single-year cross-sections: each edition reports its own year only, with no retrospective trend axis. No (organism, regional_centre, antibiotic, year) key is therefore covered by more than one edition, so cross-edition revision detection has almost nothing to compare. An empty or near-empty result here is BY DESIGN, not a sign the check failed -- contrast revisions.json (V1), where every year is covered up to three times. See the README section 'Regional Centre tables are a single-year cross-section'.
